info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Instrument Reference Data Validation API
info.description: This API facilitates the validation of financial instrument reference data, ensuring accuracy and compliance in market data management. By leveraging this endpoint, users can submit specific reference data for validation against predefined criteria. Typical consumers include financial institutions and data management systems focusing on maintaining high-quality financial records. The API serves as an essential tool for enhancing the reliability of market data, aiding firms in their regulatory obligations and internal data governance.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a validation for a specific financial instrument reference. It ensures that the data entered meets the necessary criteria and helps maintain the integrity of financial data management.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to validate financial instrument reference data for resource RES-100045. Ensure that all required fields are provided correctly to facilitate accurate validation, which may involve checking the integrity and conformity of the provided data against established standards.
